title: Rule descriptions: schema field, seeded texts, item text-field flip, richer reference rendering
description:
The rules/gates reference projection (ebb6ad45, epic 2821e177) renders gates as `title: description` but rules as bare metadata (`severity: error, enforce: true`) because the rule data model carries no free-text field: a rule's name is its only human-readable content, and the rule item kind declares `text-field = "name"`. The rich explanations that DO exist in `.jit/rules.toml` are TOML comments, invisible to every consumer (renderer, `jit item show`, future tooling).

Add an optional `description` field to the rule schema and thread it through every rule-consuming surface:

1. Schema: `description` (optional string) on the rule TOML schema and the typed load path (`RawRule`/`Rule` in the ruleset store); absent field falls back to the name everywhere, so existing repos stay valid.
2. Seeded defaults: `jit init`'s scaffolded default ruleset gains hand-authored descriptions for every seeded rule; source material is the existing comment blocks in this repo's `.jit/rules.toml` (condensed). This repo's live `rules.toml` entries also gain descriptions.
3. Item projection: flip the rule item kind's `text-field` from `name` to `description` (live `.jit/config.toml` `[item_kinds.rule]` and the `jit init` config template), so `jit item show @/rule/<name>` displays real text; name fallback covers description-less rules.
4. Renderer: `validation/rules_gates_projection.rs` renders rules as `**@/rule/<name>** — <description> (error, enforced)` mirroring the gate line; metadata suffix is prose (`error, enforced` / `warn, advisory`) instead of `severity: ..., enforce: ...`. Re-render the live `docs/reference/rules-and-gates.md`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: the rule schema accepts an optional `description`; a description-less rule loads unchanged and falls back to its name in every consumer (load-path unit tests cover both).
- [hard] REQ-02: every `jit init`-seeded default rule carries a description, and this repo's live `.jit/rules.toml` entries do too.
- [hard] REQ-03: the rule item kind's `text-field` is `description` (live config + init template); `jit item show @/rule/<name>` displays the description, with name fallback verified by test.
- [hard] REQ-04: the reference projection renders rule descriptions with the prose metadata suffix, verified by a render test; the live `docs/reference/rules-and-gates.md` is re-rendered.
